---
title: "Exploring: Checklist"
description: "A submission checklist for the Exploring Music in Context component."
categories: [Reference, Assessment, Exploring]
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
*See also: [Assessment Rubrics → Exploring](../resources/rubrics.html#exploring-music-in-context)*
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var PIECES_KEY = 'pieces:exploring';
  var CB_KEY     = 'checklist:exploring';
  var N          = 4;
  var AOI_OPTS   = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var CTX_OPTS   = ['', 'Personal', 'Local', 'Global'];
  var PRAC_OPTS  = ['', 'Creating', 'Performing'];
  var INP = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var SEL = INP + 'cursor:pointer;';
  var TH  = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD  = 'padding:.25rem .2rem;';

  var show4th = false;

  function blank() { return { name:'', composer:'', genre:'', aoi:'', context:'', practical:'' }; }
  function loadPieces() {
    try { var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PIECES_KEY))||[]; while(d.length<N)d.push(blank()); return d.slice(0,N); }
    catch(e) { return Array(N).fill(null).map(blank); }
  }
  var pieces = loadPieces();
  // Auto-detect 4th piece from stored data
  show4th = !!(pieces[3].name || pieces[3].composer || pieces[3].genre);

  function savePieces() { try{localStorage.setItem(PIECES_KEY,JSON.stringify(pieces));}catch(e){} }
  function esc(s) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

  // ── Upload timing / word-count helpers ────────────────────────────────────────
  var TH2 = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD2 = 'padding:.25rem .3rem;vertical-align:middle;';
  var INP2 = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';

  function fmtTime(s) { var m=Math.floor(s/60),r=s%60; return m+':'+(r<10?'0':'')+r; }

  function timeBar(secs, maxSecs) {
    var over = secs > maxSecs;
    var pct = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs,1) : 0;
    var barColor, timeColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; timeColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; timeColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+timeColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+fmtTime(secs)+'</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function wordBar(words, maxWords) {
    var over = words > maxWords;
    var pct = maxWords ? Math.min(words/maxWords*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxWords ? Math.min(words/maxWords,1) : 0;
    var barColor, wordColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; wordColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; wordColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+wordColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+words+' words</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+maxWords+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function inlineOverWarning(secs, maxSecs) {
    return secs > maxSecs ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.72rem;margin-left:.4rem;">&#9888; over '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+'</span>' : '';
  }

  // ── Piece link helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var JUMP_BTN = 'background:none;border:none;padding:0;color:#5b9bd5;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline dotted;font-family:inherit;';

  function pieceDisplayText(idx) {
    var p = pieces[idx];
    var name = p && p.name;
    return name ? esc(name) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">Piece '+(idx+1)+'</em>';
  }

  function pieceJumpBtn(idx, html, extraStyle) {
    return '<button onclick="expJumpPiece('+idx+')" style="'+JUMP_BTN+'font-size:.82rem;'+(extraStyle||'')+'" title="Jump to piece in repertoire">'+html+'</button>';
  }

  // ── Upload 1 word counts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var U1_KEY = 'exp-upload1-words';
  var u1 = {s1_0:'',s1_1:'',s1_2:'',s1_3:'', sec2:'', sec3:''};
  try {
    var _u1 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(U1_KEY));
    if (_u1) { u1.s1_0=_u1.s1_0||''; u1.s1_1=_u1.s1_1||''; u1.s1_2=_u1.s1_2||''; u1.s1_3=_u1.s1_3||''; u1.sec2=_u1.sec2||''; u1.sec3=_u1.sec3||''; }
  } catch(e) {}
  function saveU1() { try{localStorage.setItem(U1_KEY,JSON.stringify(u1));}catch(e){} }

  // Word count recommendation per piece
  function pieceWordRec(hasPractical, count) {
    if (count === 4) {
      return hasPractical ? '375–450' : '450–600';
    }
    return hasPractical ? '500–600' : '600–800';
  }

  function renderUpload1() {
    var c = document.getElementById('upload1-tracker');
    if (!c) return;

    var count1 = show4th ? 4 : 3;
    var S1_KEYS = ['s1_0','s1_1','s1_2','s1_3'];

    // Section 2 link — creating piece
    var creIdx = -1;
    for (var ci=0; ci<N; ci++) { if (pieces[ci].practical==='Creating') { creIdx=ci; break; } }
    var sec2Suffix = ': ' + (creIdx>=0 ? pieceJumpBtn(creIdx, pieceDisplayText(creIdx)) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">no piece selected</em>');

    // Section 3 link — performing piece
    var perfIdx = -1;
    for (var pi=0; pi<N; pi++) { if (pieces[pi].practical==='Performing') { perfIdx=pi; break; } }
    var sec3Suffix = ': ' + (perfIdx>=0 ? pieceJumpBtn(perfIdx, pieceDisplayText(perfIdx)) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">no piece selected</em>');

    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Section</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Recommended</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:8em;">Word count</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';

    // Section 1 header row
    h += '<tr style="background:#f5f3ef;">'
      +'<td colspan="3" style="padding:.25rem .3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#999;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">Section 1</td>'
      +'</tr>';

    // One row per piece
    for (var r=0; r<count1; r++) {
      var hasPrac = !!(pieces[r] && pieces[r].practical);
      var rec = pieceWordRec(hasPrac, count1);
      var key = S1_KEYS[r];
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'padding-left:.8rem;">'+pieceJumpBtn(r, pieceDisplayText(r))+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">'+rec+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" data-u1key="'+key+'" value="'+esc(String(u1[key]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    }

    // Section 2 and 3 rows
    var extraRows = [
      { key:'sec2', label:'Section 2', suffix: sec2Suffix, hint:'~300' },
      { key:'sec3', label:'Section 3', suffix: sec3Suffix, hint:'~300' }
    ];
    extraRows.forEach(function(row) {
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.82rem;">'+row.label+row.suffix+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">'+row.hint+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" data-u1key="'+row.key+'" value="'+esc(String(u1[row.key]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    });

    h += '</tbody></table>';

    var total = (parseInt(u1.sec2)||0) + (parseInt(u1.sec3)||0);
    for (var ti=0; ti<count1; ti++) { total += parseInt(u1[S1_KEYS[ti]])||0; }
    h += wordBar(total, 2400);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-u1key]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { u1[el.dataset.u1key] = el.value; saveU1(); renderUpload1(); });
    });
  }

  // ── Upload 2 times ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var U2_KEY = 'exp-upload2-times';
  var u2 = {cMin:'',cSec:'',sMin:'',sSec:'',aMin:'',aSec:''};
  try { var _u2 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(U2_KEY)); if(_u2) u2 = _u2; } catch(e) {}
  function saveU2() { try{localStorage.setItem(U2_KEY,JSON.stringify(u2));}catch(e){} }

  function renderUpload2() {
    var c = document.getElementById('upload2-tracker');
    if (!c) return;

    // Locate creating and performing pieces
    var cIdx = -1, pIdx = -1;
    for (var xi=0; xi<N; xi++) {
      if (pieces[xi].practical==='Creating'   && cIdx<0) cIdx=xi;
      if (pieces[xi].practical==='Performing' && pIdx<0) pIdx=xi;
    }

    // Creating exercise suffix: "in the style of [GENRE]"
    var genreHtml;
    if (cIdx >= 0 && pieces[cIdx].genre) {
      genreHtml = pieceJumpBtn(cIdx, esc(pieces[cIdx].genre));
    } else if (cIdx >= 0) {
      genreHtml = pieceJumpBtn(cIdx, '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">no genre entered</em>');
    } else {
      genreHtml = '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">no piece selected</em>';
    }
    var creLabel = 'Creating exercise <span style="font-size:.78rem;color:#666;">in the style of </span>' + genreHtml;

    // Stimulus suffix: ": [title of performing piece]"
    var stimTitleHtml = pIdx>=0 ? pieceJumpBtn(pIdx, pieceDisplayText(pIdx)) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">no piece selected</em>';
    var stimLabel = 'Stimulus<span style="font-size:.78rem;color:#666;">: </span>' + stimTitleHtml;

    // Performed adaptation suffix: "of [title of performing piece]"
    var adaptTitleHtml = pIdx>=0 ? pieceJumpBtn(pIdx, pieceDisplayText(pIdx)) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">no piece selected</em>';
    var adaptLabel = 'Performed adaptation <span style="font-size:.78rem;color:#666;">of </span>' + adaptTitleHtml;

    var rows = [
      { label: creLabel,  minKey:'cMin', secKey:'cSec', maxSecs:60 },
      { label: stimLabel, minKey:'sMin', secKey:'sSec', maxSecs:60 },
      { label: adaptLabel,minKey:'aMin', secKey:'aSec', maxSecs:120 }
    ];
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Section</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Max</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'"></th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
      var secs = (parseInt(u2[row.minKey])||0)*60 + (parseInt(u2[row.secKey])||0);
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.82rem;">'+row.label+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">'+fmtTime(row.maxSecs)+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-u2key="'+row.minKey+'" value="'+esc(String(u2[row.minKey]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-u2key="'+row.secKey+'" value="'+esc(String(u2[row.secKey]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#c0392b;">'+inlineOverWarning(secs, row.maxSecs)+'</td>'
        +'</tr>';
    });
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    var totalSecs = (parseInt(u2.cMin)||0)*60+(parseInt(u2.cSec)||0)
                  +(parseInt(u2.sMin)||0)*60+(parseInt(u2.sSec)||0)
                  +(parseInt(u2.aMin)||0)*60+(parseInt(u2.aSec)||0);
    h += timeBar(totalSecs, 4*60);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-u2key]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { u2[el.dataset.u2key] = el.value; saveU2(); renderUpload2(); });
    });
  }

  // ── Upload 3 times (per piece) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var U3_KEY = 'exp-upload3-times';
  var u3 = [{min:'',sec:''},{min:'',sec:''},{min:'',sec:''},{min:'',sec:''}];
  try {
    var _u3 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(U3_KEY));
    if (Array.isArray(_u3)) { for(var _i=0;_i<4;_i++){ if(_u3[_i]) u3[_i]={min:_u3[_i].min||'',sec:_u3[_i].sec||''}; } }
  } catch(e) {}
  function saveU3() { try{localStorage.setItem(U3_KEY,JSON.stringify(u3));}catch(e){} }

  function renderUpload3() {
    var c = document.getElementById('upload3-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var count = show4th ? 4 : 3;
    var recSecs = count === 4 ? 45 : 60; // 0:45 per piece for 4 pieces, 1:00 for 3
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Piece</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:7em;">Recommended</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<count; r++) {
      var numLabel = '<span style="font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;margin-right:.3rem;">Piece '+(r+1)+'</span>';
      var titleBtn = pieceJumpBtn(r, pieceDisplayText(r));
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'">'+numLabel+titleBtn+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">'+fmtTime(recSecs)+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-u3row="'+r+'" data-u3field="min" value="'+esc(String(u3[r].min||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-u3row="'+r+'" data-u3field="sec" value="'+esc(String(u3[r].sec||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    var totalSecs3 = 0;
    for (var ri=0; ri<count; ri++) { totalSecs3 += (parseInt(u3[ri].min)||0)*60 + (parseInt(u3[ri].sec)||0); }
    h += timeBar(totalSecs3, 3*60);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-u3row]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        u3[+el.dataset.u3row][el.dataset.u3field] = el.value;
        saveU3(); renderUpload3();
      });
    });
  }

  // Jump-and-highlight a piece row in the repertoire tracker
  window.expJumpPiece = function(rowIndex) {
    var tracker = document.getElementById('piece-tracker');
    if (!tracker) return;
    var rows = tracker.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    var target = rows[rowIndex];
    if (!target || target.style.display === 'none') return;
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
    target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight');
    void target.offsetWidth;
    target.classList.add('piece-row-highlight');
    setTimeout(function(){ target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight'); }, 2500);
  };

  function buildSel(field, opts, val, row) {
    var h = '<select data-row="'+row+'" data-field="'+field+'" style="'+SEL+'">';
    opts.forEach(function(o){ h+='<option value="'+esc(o)+'"'+(val===o?' selected':'')+'>'+(o||'—')+'</option>'; });
    return h+'</select>';
  }

  function renderTracker() {
    var c = document.getElementById('piece-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    ['Piece','Composer','Genre','AOI','Context','Practical exercise'].forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<N; r++) {
      var hidden = (r === 3 && !show4th) ? ' style="display:none;"' : '';
      h += '<tr'+hidden+'>';
      ['name','composer','genre'].forEach(function(f){
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="'+f+'" value="'+esc(pieces[r][f])+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      });
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:5em;">'+buildSel('aoi',      AOI_OPTS,  pieces[r].aoi,      r)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:7em;">'+buildSel('context',  CTX_OPTS,  pieces[r].context,  r)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:9em;">'+buildSel('practical',PRAC_OPTS, pieces[r].practical, r)+'</td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        pieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        savePieces(); runAutoChecks();
        renderUpload1(); renderUpload2(); renderUpload3();
      });
    });
    var btn = document.getElementById('toggle4th');
    if (btn) btn.textContent = show4th ? 'Remove 4th Piece' : 'Add 4th Piece';
  }

  function initAutoIndicators() {
    var headings = document.querySelectorAll('h2');
    var repEl = null;
    headings.forEach(function(h) {
      if (/repertoire/i.test(h.textContent)) repEl = h;
    });
    if (!repEl) return;
    var el = repEl.nextElementSibling;
    while (el && el.tagName !== 'H2' && el.tagName !== 'HR') {
      el.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function(li) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (!cb) return;
        cb.classList.add('auto-check');
        cb.style.display = 'none';
        cb.disabled = true;
        var lbl = li.querySelector('label');
        if (lbl) lbl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        li.style.cursor = 'default';
        var ind = document.createElement('span');
        ind.className = 'auto-indicator';
        li.insertBefore(ind, li.firstChild);
      });
      el = el.nextElementSibling;
    }
  }

  function setCheck(substr, val, error) {
    document.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function(li){
      if (li.textContent.indexOf(substr) > -1) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (!cb) return;
        cb.checked = !!val;
        var ind = li.querySelector('.auto-indicator');
        if (ind) {
          ind.classList.remove('auto-checked', 'auto-error');
          if (error) ind.classList.add('auto-error');
          else if (val) ind.classList.add('auto-checked');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function runAutoChecks() {
    var aois     = pieces.map(function(p){return p.aoi;}).filter(Boolean);
    var ctxs     = pieces.map(function(p){return p.context;}).filter(Boolean);
    var creat    = pieces.filter(function(p){return p.practical==='Creating';});
    var allPerf  = pieces.filter(function(p){return p.practical==='Performing';});
    var perf     = allPerf.filter(function(p){return p.context==='Local'||p.context==='Global';});

    setCheck('two different areas of inquiry', new Set(aois).size >= 2);
    setCheck('three contexts', ctxs.indexOf('Personal')>-1 && ctxs.indexOf('Local')>-1 && ctxs.indexOf('Global')>-1);
    setCheck('Creating exercise stimulus', creat.length >= 1);

    var adaptOk = perf.length >= 1;
    if (adaptOk && creat.length >= 1 && creat[0].aoi && perf[0].aoi) adaptOk = perf[0].aoi !== creat[0].aoi;
    var adaptError = false;
    if (allPerf.length > 0) {
      var hasPersonal = allPerf.some(function(p){ return p.context === 'Personal'; });
      var hasSameAOI  = creat.length > 0 && allPerf.some(function(p){
        return p.aoi && creat[0].aoi && p.aoi === creat[0].aoi;
      });
      adaptError = hasPersonal || hasSameAOI;
    }
    setCheck('Performed adaptation stimulus', adaptOk, adaptError);
  }

  var boxes;
  function saveCheckboxes() {
    try{localStorage.setItem(CB_KEY,JSON.stringify((boxes||[]).map(function(b){return b.checked;})));}catch(e){}
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    renderTracker();
    initAutoIndicators();
    boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'))
      .filter(function(cb){ return !cb.classList.contains('auto-check'); });
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.removeAttribute('disabled'); cb.style.cursor='pointer'; });
    try {
      var sv = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CB_KEY));
      if (Array.isArray(sv)) boxes.forEach(function(cb,i){ if(sv[i]!==undefined)cb.checked=!!sv[i]; });
    } catch(e) {}
    runAutoChecks();
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.addEventListener('change', saveCheckboxes); });

    renderUpload1();
    renderUpload2();
    renderUpload3();

    var btn = document.getElementById('toggle4th');
    if (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        show4th = !show4th;
        if (!show4th) { pieces[3] = blank(); savePieces(); }
        renderTracker();
        runAutoChecks();
        renderUpload3();
      });
    }
  });

  window.resetExploringChecklist = function() {
    if (boxes) { boxes.forEach(function(b){b.checked=false;}); saveCheckboxes(); }
  };
})();
</script>
```

## Repertoire decisions

<div id="piece-tracker" style="margin-bottom:.5rem;overflow-x:auto;"></div>

<div style="margin-bottom:1rem;">
<button id="toggle4th" style="font-size:.78rem;padding:.2rem .6rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#666;cursor:pointer;">Add 4th Piece</button>
</div>

- [ ] At least **two different areas of inquiry** are represented across all pieces
- [ ] All **three contexts** are covered: personal, local, and global
- [ ] Creating exercise stimulus is identified (a piece explored in Section 1)
- [ ] Performed adaptation stimulus is identified: **local or global context**, different AOI from creating

---

## Section 1: Exploration of diverse musical material

**For each piece:**

- [ ] Area of inquiry is **stated and justified** — not just named ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] Context (personal/local/global) is justified ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] **Musical findings** are present (from scores/recordings): conventions, devices, techniques ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] Musical findings are located with **bar numbers or exact timestamps** pointing to [Upload 3](#upload-3-audio-reference-material) ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] **Extra-musical findings** are present (from articles, interviews, etc.) ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] Extra-musical findings are **relevant** to the music — not anecdotal biography ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] All sources have **in-text citations** — not only a bibliography at the end ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] Analysis explains *why* devices are used ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain) · [EMC B2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b2,rt-explain))

---

## Section 2: Creating exercise

- [ ] Based on a style **explored in [Section 1](#section-1-exploration-of-diverse-musical-material)** ([EMC B2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b2,rt-explain) · [EMC C1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c1,rt-realize))
- [ ] Creating exercise audio included in [Upload 2](#upload-2-audio-evidence) *(max 1 min)*
- [ ] Score or notation **embedded in the [written document](#upload-1-written-document)** (max 32 bars or 1 min audio)
- [ ] Notation is appropriate to the style and clearly communicates the exercise ([EMC C1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c1,rt-realize))
- [ ] Statement explains which **creating conventions** were applied and **where** ([EMC C1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c1,rt-realize))
- [ ] Statement explains how **[Section 1](#section-1-exploration-of-diverse-musical-material) research directly informed** the exercise ([EMC B2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b2,rt-explain) · [EMC C1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c1,rt-realize))

---

## Section 3: Performed adaptation

- [ ] Stimulus (original music) included in [Upload 2](#upload-2-audio-evidence) *(max 1 min)*
- [ ] Performed adaptation audio included in [Upload 2](#upload-2-audio-evidence) *(max 2 min)*
- [ ] From a **local or global** context — NOT personal ([EMC C2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c2,rt-shape))
- [ ] Statement explains which **performing practices** were identified in the original style ([EMC C2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c2,rt-shape))
- [ ] Statement explains how practices were **adapted for your instrument** ([EMC C2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c2,rt-shape))
- [ ] Adaptation AOI is confirmed as **different from [creating](#section-2-creating-exercise)** AOI ([EMC C1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c1,rt-realize) · [EMC C2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c2,rt-shape))

---

## Upload 1: Written document

```{=html}
<div id="upload1-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
```

- [ ] Word count is within **2,400 words** (in-text citations and bibliography excluded)
- [ ] Compiled in one pdf in order: **[Section 1](#section-1-exploration-of-diverse-musical-material) → [Section 2](#section-2-creating-exercise) → [Section 3](#section-3-performed-adaptation) → Bibliography**
- [ ] Visual evidence is **embedded in the text**, not appended
- [ ] Visual evidence does not exceed **5 pages**
- [ ] Score for creating exercise is embedded in [Section 2](#section-2-creating-exercise)
- [ ] Track list and timings for [Upload 2](#upload-2-audio-evidence) and [Upload 3](#upload-3-audio-reference-material) included as appendix (not in word count)
- [ ] Bibliography complete and includes all scores, recordings, and secondary sources

---

## Upload 2: Audio evidence

```{=html}
<div id="upload2-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
```

- [ ] Total audio does not exceed **4 minutes**
- [ ] Compiled in order: **[Creating exercise](#section-2-creating-exercise) → [Stimulus](#section-3-performed-adaptation) → [Performed adaptation](#section-3-performed-adaptation)**
- [ ] Creating exercise audio does not exceed **1 minute**
- [ ] Stimulus does not exceed **1 minute**
- [ ] Performed adaptation does not exceed **2 minutes**
- [ ] Audio quality allows full assessment of the exercises
- [ ] Exact timings are specified in the [written document](#upload-1-written-document)

---

## Upload 3: Audio reference material

```{=html}
<div id="upload3-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
```

- [ ] Total audio does not exceed **3 minutes**
- [ ] Contains only excerpts of **music analysed in [Section 1](#section-1-exploration-of-diverse-musical-material)**
- [ ] Compiled in the order excerpts appear in the writing
- [ ] Timestamps in Upload 3 match the references in the [written document](#upload-1-written-document)

---

## Common errors to rule out

- [ ] Timestamps in writing point to **[Upload 3](#upload-3-audio-reference-material)** — not to YouTube, Spotify, or original commercial recordings
- [ ] Score excerpts are **annotated** and connected to specific analytical claims — not decorative ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] AOIs are **justified with musical evidence** — not just labelled ([EMC B1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b1,rt-explain))
- [ ] Creating exercise and performed adaptation are from **two different AOIs** ([EMC C1](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c1,rt-realize) · [EMC C2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c2,rt-shape))
- [ ] Performed adaptation is based on **local or global** music — not personal ([EMC C2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-c2,rt-shape))
- [ ] Creating exercise and adaptation are both referenced **back to [Section 1](#section-1-exploration-of-diverse-musical-material) research** ([EMC B2](../resources/rubrics.html#emc-b2,rt-explain))
- [ ] Word count checked with citations removed
